title.zh: 分子三通道散射源归约

summary: The source-order sum Swall + Beta_CX + OmegaM of the molecular wall, charge-exchange and elastic scattered-generation source distributions on one velocity-space mesh, preserving signed values.

identity.relation: Beta = Swall + Beta_CX + OmegaM pointwise on one (nvr,nvx,nx) mesh
identity.direction: three aligned source fields -> their pointwise sum in the declared order
identity.definition: Plain pointwise addition in the order wall, CX, elastic; no clamping of signed values
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis
identity.coordinates: all fields in the source's discrete source-distribution units
identity.boundary: three finite aligned three-dimensional fields; signed values preserved
assumptions: The wall-source channel exists only on the molecular side; this is why the molecular reduction is a separate asset from its atomic sibling.
The caller owns the per-channel source construction; this asset only aggregates.

Fail-closed finiteness: extreme-but-valid inputs can overflow, so this asset rejects a non-finite result instead of returning it, per the declared finite-output contract. A bounded regression test pins that behaviour.

inputs.name: wall_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field; signed values preserved.

inputs.name: charge_exchange_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field aligned to the wall field.

inputs.name: elastic_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field aligned to the wall field.

outputs.name: total_source
outputs.constraints: The pointwise sum in the declared order; finite; signed values preserved.

supported: Molecular generation-source aggregation on a shared mesh.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for implicit boolean, string or complex conversion, non-finite inputs, or misaligned three-dimensional source fields.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Aggregate three molecular sources in the declared order and reject misalignment.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import reduce_molecular_scattered_sources
rng = np.random.default_rng(31)
wall, cx, elastic = (rng.random((2, 3, 4)) for _ in range(3))
result = reduce_molecular_scattered_sources(wall, cx, elastic)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result, wall + cx + elastic)
try:
    reduce_molecular_scattered_sources(wall, cx, np.ones((2, 3, 5)))
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'finite aligned 3-D' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('a misaligned field must be rejected')
example.expected: The returned field equaled wall + charge_exchange + elastic elementwise, and a misaligned 3-D field raised ValueError.
